what: Session codebook functions added to this package
title: DB and SQL Helper Functions
text: Note: write_session_codebook() moved cori.utils, joining load_session_metadata(), already lived . part session-metadata lifecycle: pull_metadata() (internal) writes table/field/source metadata temp directory queries run database, load_session_metadata() reads back, write_session_codebook() exports Excel file Google Sheet. Keeping three together avoids splitting one feature across two packages.
